citations.assessment: Vayikra Rabbah directly names Rav Shalom and gives this chain.
The standard Tanhuma directly names R. Yehudah bar R. Shalom in the name of R. Yehudah bar R. Simon. Buber’s near parallel has R. Yehudah ha-Levi bar R. Shalom with a different attribution.

citations.assessment: The introductory quotation is from Hosea 9:7. The Hebrew spelling at the end differs between the received report and the biblical text, without requiring a change in the English here.

holds.reason: Heilprin expressly leaves the episode unidentified. Do not admit a reconstruction.

notes.text: Emor attributes the saying to Rav Shalom. The checked Tanhuma gives a different transmitting name. The mystical work and reported episode remain qualified.
